blocks.text: F1 dihybrid paude (RrYy) mein beej ki shakal ke alleles R aur r, aur beej ke rang ke alleles Y aur y hain. Gametes bante waqt chaar milap bante hain: RY, Ry, rY aur ry. Jab yeh gametes milte hain (4 male × 4 female gametes) to F2 mein 16 milap bante hain. Is se F2 mein chaar phenotypes 9:3:3:1 ratio mein aate hain:

Nataij se pata chala ke beej ki shakal ke genes beej ke rang ke genes se azad ho kar alag hote hain. Is bunyad par Mendel ne kaha: 'gametes bante waqt alleles ka har jora doosre joron se azad ho kar alag hota hai'. Ise Mendel ka law of independent assortment kehte hain.
